## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is based on `main`, and its commits are isolated and self-contained (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Grollo13/FreeTheLights/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] Commit messages follow `<area>: <imperative summary>` with a body explaining what and why.
- [ ] Every commit builds without warnings and passes the tests.
- [ ] Tests are in the same commit as the code they test.
- [ ] `README.md` / `CLAUDE.md` are updated if the change needs it.
- [ ] If the settings format changed: `CurrentVersion` is bumped, with a migration step and a `settings-v<new>.json` fixture.
- [ ] UI changes are checked (screenshots below, e.g. from `tools/harness.sh`).
